Ransom Note About

Privacy policy

Last updated 11 August 2026.

88cutouts has no accounts and no sign-up. You never give us your name, email address or any other personal detail to use the site, and there is no server that stores anything you do here. Copying a sticker, downloading one, and typing in the ransom-note tool all happen entirely in your own browser.

Analytics

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how many people visit and which stickers get used. It sets cookies and records things like the pages you view, your approximate location (country/city level, derived from your IP address), and your device and browser type. We also record when someone copies or downloads a sticker, and what terms are searched for — so we know what to draw next. None of this identifies you personally, and we never try to link it to a real identity.

Google's own handling of this data is covered by the Google Privacy Policy. You can opt out across all sites with the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on, or by blocking cookies in your browser settings — the site works exactly the same either way.

Advertising

We intend to show ads through Google AdSense. Ads are not running yet. When they are, Google and its partners may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. You can manage this at Google My Ad Center. This page will be updated when ads go live.

Hosting

The site is served as static files by Cloudflare Pages. Cloudflare processes standard request logs (including IP addresses) to deliver the site and protect it from abuse. Fonts are self-hosted, so no font provider sees your visit.

What we don't do

We don't sell data, we don't run email marketing, we don't have a newsletter, and we don't ask you to log in. There is no user-generated content and nothing you type into the ransom-note tool ever leaves your device.

Children

This site isn't directed at children under 13 and we don't knowingly collect data from them.

Contact

Questions about any of this, or want something removed? Email hello@88cutouts.com.
